news.title: Analyst Rating and Stock Surge
news.text: H.C. Wainwright lifted its price target for BigBear.ai from $6 to $9 while reiterating a Buy rating, helping drive a 12.7% jump in the shares.

news.title: BigBear.ai and DEFCON AI Collaborate
news.text: BigBear.ai and DEFCON AI announced a collaboration aimed at advancing next-generation military readiness capabilities.

news.title: Q2 2025 Earnings Miss Expectations
news.text: BigBear.ai reported second-quarter 2025 revenue of $32.5 million, down 18% year over year, with a widened net loss of $228.6 million, missing analyst forecasts and pressuring the stock.

news.title: Full-Year 2025 Outlook Revised
news.text: Following its earnings report, the company lowered full-year 2025 revenue guidance to a range of $125 million to $140 million due to softer Army program volume.

news.title: Smiths Detection Integration Completed
news.text: BigBear.ai and Smiths Detection completed testing and integration of their systems to advance airport security capabilities.

news.title: BigBear.ai and Narval Holding Launch Cargo Security Solution
news.text: The company partnered with Narval Holding Corp. to deploy an AI-powered cargo security management platform in Panama.

news.title: BigBear.ai and Washington Commanders Partnership
news.text: BigBear.ai announced a landmark collaboration with the Washington Commanders to deliver AI-driven insights for football operations.

news.title: AI Deployment at Nashville International Airport
news.text: The company expanded its biometric screening deployment at Nashville International Airport to accelerate U.S. arrivals processing.

news.title: BigBear.ai Supports Navy UNITAS Exercise
news.text: BigBear.ai partnered with SMX to deliver AI-enabled sensor fusion and situational awareness during the U.S. Navy's UNITAS 2025 maritime exercise.

news.title: BigBear.ai Partners with Tsecond
news.text: BigBear.ai and Tsecond agreed to deliver AI-enabled edge infrastructure for battlefield applications, aiming to accelerate decision-making in the field.

news.title: Chicago O'Hare Deploys BigBear.ai Biometrics
news.text: The company announced its biometric system is being used at Chicago O'Hare International Airport to enhance security and streamline international travel.
